print.echoes_in_ink.printers_instruction: 1. Seat the matrix on the carriage bed.
2. Charge the form with ink ball or pad.
3. Lay clean or damaged archive paper.
4. Push the carriage, pull the handle, wait.
5. Withdraw the carriage and take the print. Empty hand + sneak removes the form.
print.echoes_in_ink.workshop_map_fragmen: Fragment of a survey map — charcoal and ink.
A second archive is marked beyond the workshop grounds.
Look for temperate woods and soft earth.
The restored chronicle will sharpen the path.

print.echoes_in_ink.printed_warning_post: Keep hands clear of the screw and platen.
Do not leave charged ink forms overnight.
Report any seized carriage to the master printer.
By order of the workshop — hang where all may see.
